independent_expectations.len: len equals the exact remaining slice element count.
independent_expectations.slice_tail: Err(Error::InvalidLength) iff nbytes > remaining length. Otherwise Ok with length nbytes, pointer remaining.as_ptr() + (remaining length - nbytes), and bytes equal the last nbytes. No panic; receiver unchanged.

native_cases.nbytes: Every0..=len plus len+1, usize::MAX/2, usize::MAX-1, usize::MAX.
native_cases.checks: Every ordinary query checks len before/after and receiver pointer/length. Each backing view additionally returns a tail beyond the lifetime of its temporary Line owner.
